quote: Furthermore, our unpublished data indicate that the attenuated live MRV vaccine, but not the inactivated MRV vaccine, provides effective protection against virulent MRV challenge in the mandarin fish model.
statement: 未发表的数据表明，减毒活MRV疫苗（而非灭活MRV疫苗）在鳜鱼模型中提供了针对强毒力MRV攻击的有效保护。
text_zh: 未发表的数据表明，减毒活MRV疫苗（而非灭活MRV疫苗）在鳜鱼模型中提供了针对强毒力MRV攻击的有效保护。
text_en: Unpublished data indicate that the attenuated live MRV vaccine (but not the inactivated MRV vaccine) provided effective protection against challenge with virulent MRV in a mandarin fish model.

quote: fibrinous serositis characterized by severe congestion and edema in pyloric ceca, which is attributed to MRV primarily infecting mandarin fish serosa and resulting in pronounced serosal hyperplasia.
statement: MRV主要感染鳜鱼浆膜，导致明显的浆膜增生，并引起幽门盲肠严重的充血和水肿性纤维素性浆膜炎。
text_zh: MRV主要感染鳜鱼浆膜，导致明显的浆膜增生，并引起幽门盲肠严重的充血和水肿性纤维素性浆膜炎。
text_en: MRV mainly infects the serosa of mandarin fish, causing obvious serosal hyperplasia and inducing severe congestion and edematous fibrinous serositis in the pyloric caeca.

quote: Simultaneously, due to the loose ECM structure, significant cell infiltration and interstitial fluid leakage resulted in severe ascites syndrome.
statement: 同时，由于松散的细胞外基质结构，显著的细胞浸润和间质液泄漏导致了严重的腹水综合征。
text_zh: 同时，由于松散的细胞外基质结构，显著的细胞浸润和间质液泄漏导致了严重的腹水综合征。
text_en: At the same time, due to the loose extracellular matrix structure, significant cell infiltration and interstitial fluid leakage led to severe ascites syndrome.
outcome: 腹水综合征与体液平衡

quote: MRV-ZQ17 strain was isolated and characterized from a natural mass mortality of juvenile mandarin fish
statement: MRV-ZQ17毒株是从幼鳜的自然大规模死亡中分离和鉴定的。
text_zh: MRV-ZQ17毒株是从幼鳜的自然大规模死亡中分离和鉴定的。
text_en: The MRV-ZQ17 strain was isolated and identified from a natural mass mortality of juvenile mandarin fish.

quote: Similar to viral infections in mammals, ranavirus-induced inflammation is a double-edged sword: while it is essential for viral clearance, it can also exacerbate disease progression and negatively impact host survival ( 47 – 49 ).
statement: 类似于哺乳动物的病毒感染，蛙病毒引起的炎症是一把双刃剑：虽然它对病毒清除至关重要，但也可能加剧疾病进展并对宿主生存产生负面影响。
text_zh: 类似于哺乳动物的病毒感染，蛙病毒引起的炎症是一把双刃剑：虽然它对病毒清除至关重要，但也可能加剧疾病进展并对宿主生存产生负面影响。
text_en: Similar to viral infections in mammals, inflammation caused by ranavirus is a double-edged sword: although it is essential for virus clearance, it may also exacerbate disease progression and negatively affect host survival.

quote: Previous studies have observed that ranavirus infection induces the expression of inflammatory genes such as interleukin-1-β (IL-1β), tumor necrosis factor-α (TNFα), and the anti-inflammatory arginase-1 (Arg-1) ( 44 , 50 , 51 ).
statement: 先前的研究观察到，蛙病毒感染会诱导白细胞介素-1β (IL-1β)、肿瘤坏死因子-α (TNFα) 和抗炎精氨酸酶-1 (Arg-1) 等炎症基因的表达。
text_zh: 先前的研究观察到，蛙病毒感染会诱导白细胞介素-1β (IL-1β)、肿瘤坏死因子-α (TNFα) 和抗炎精氨酸酶-1 (Arg-1) 等炎症基因的表达。
text_en: Previous studies observed that ranavirus infection induces the expression of inflammatory genes such as interleukin-1β (IL-1β), tumor necrosis factor-α (TNFα), and anti-inflammatory arginase-1 (Arg-1).

quote: In this study, we found that the acute MRV infection rapidly initiated the increase in many inflammatory factors.
statement: 在本研究中，我们发现急性MRV感染迅速引发了许多炎症因子的增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，我们发现急性MRV感染迅速引发了许多炎症因子的增加。
text_en: In this study, we found that acute MRV infection rapidly triggered an increase in many inflammatory factors.

population.species: 未知 (文中未明确具体物种，仅提及MRV)

quote: However, these inflammatory responses are insufficient to clear the virus and may, in fact, worsen the disease and negatively affect host survival.
statement: 然而，这些炎症反应不足以清除病毒，事实上可能会加重疾病并对宿主生存产生负面影响。
text_zh: 然而，这些炎症反应不足以清除病毒，事实上可能会加重疾病并对宿主生存产生负面影响。
text_en: However, these inflammatory responses are insufficient to clear the virus and may in fact exacerbate the disease and negatively affect host survival.

population.species: 未知 (文中未明确具体物种，仅提及MRV)

quote: (c) T cells, B cells, fibroblasts, myofibroblasts, endothelial cells, and pericytes in the hypertrophic serosal zone are targeted by MRV, driving ECM formation, collagen encoding, and blood vessel morphogenesis; the infected pyloric ceca ultimately shows congestion, edema, and adhesions;
statement: 肥厚浆膜区中的T细胞、B细胞及多种基质细胞是MRV的靶标，驱动ECM形成、胶原编码和血管形态发生；受感染的幽门盲肠最终表现为充血、水肿和粘连。
text_zh: 肥厚浆膜区中的T细胞、B细胞及多种基质细胞是MRV的靶标，驱动ECM形成、胶原编码和血管形态发生；受感染的幽门盲肠最终表现为充血、水肿和粘连。
text_en: T cells, B cells, and various stromal cells in the hypertrophic serosal area are targets of MRV, driving ECM formation, collagen encoding, and vascular morphogenesis; infected pyloric caeca ultimately present with congestion, edema, and adhesions.

quote: Factors such as the habitat coloration preference in the aquaculture environment of S. chuatsi may influence its welfare [ 20 ].
statement: 鳜鱼养殖环境中的栖息地颜色偏好等因素可能会影响其福利。
text_zh: 鳜鱼养殖环境中的栖息地颜色偏好等因素可能会影响其福利。
text_en: Factors such as habitat color preference in the farming environment of mandarin fish may affect their welfare.

quote: Studying the habitat coloration preference of carnivorous fish can help to achieve a more comprehensive understanding of fish behavior, thereby enabling the optimization of aquaculture environments and enhancing fish welfare [ 22 , 23 , 24 ].
statement: 研究肉食性鱼类的栖息地颜色偏好有助于更全面地理解鱼类行为，从而优化养殖环境并提高鱼类福利。
text_zh: 研究肉食性鱼类的栖息地颜色偏好有助于更全面地理解鱼类行为，从而优化养殖环境并提高鱼类福利。
text_en: Studying the habitat color preferences of carnivorous fish helps to more comprehensively understand fish behavior, thereby optimizing the farming environment and improving fish welfare.

quote: The purpose of this study was to examine the influence of habitat coloration on fish behavior, so as to improve animal welfare in aquaculture as well.
statement: 本研究的目的是考察栖息地颜色对鱼类行为的影响，从而改善水产养殖中的动物福利。
text_zh: 本研究的目的是考察栖息地颜色对鱼类行为的影响，从而改善水产养殖中的动物福利。
text_en: The purpose of this study was to examine the effect of habitat color on fish behavior, thereby improving animal welfare in aquaculture.

quote: These findings contribute to optimizing aquaculture environments to enhance fish health and welfare while offering new insights into behavioral adaptations in fish.
statement: 这些研究结果有助于优化水产养殖环境以增强鱼类的健康和福利，并为鱼类行为适应提供新的见解。
text_zh: 这些研究结果有助于优化水产养殖环境以增强鱼类的健康和福利，并为鱼类行为适应提供新的见解。
text_en: These research results help optimize aquaculture environments to enhance fish health and welfare, and provide new insights into fish behavioral adaptation.

quote: The living environment, husbandry practices, and management techniques employed in aquaculture settings can directly or indirectly compromise the mental and physical well-being of animals
statement: 水产养殖环境中采用的生活环境、饲养实践和管理技术可能直接或间接损害动物的身心健康。
text_zh: 水产养殖环境中采用的生活环境、饲养实践和管理技术可能直接或间接损害动物的身心健康。
text_en: The living environment, husbandry practices and management techniques adopted in aquaculture environments may directly or indirectly harm the physical and mental health of animals.

quote: Before the experiment, the fish were fasted for 24 h to ensure optimal activity levels and sensitivity to the surrounding environment.
statement: 实验前对鱼禁食24小时，以确保其最佳的活动水平和对周围环境的敏感性。
text_zh: 实验前对鱼禁食24小时，以确保其最佳的活动水平和对周围环境的敏感性。
text_en: Fish were fasted for 24 hours before the experiment to ensure their optimal activity level and sensitivity to the surrounding environment.
outcome: 活动水平与环境敏感性

quote: The water depth was maintained at 20 cm throughout the experiments.
statement: 在整个实验过程中，水深保持在20厘米。
text_zh: 在整个实验过程中，水深保持在20厘米。
text_en: Throughout the entire experiment, the water depth was maintained at 20 centimeters.

quote: changes in the aquatic environment can trigger stress responses in animals, which in turn affect their natural behavior and reduce aquaculture production
statement: 水生环境的变化会引发动物的应激反应，进而影响其自然行为并降低水产养殖产量。
text_zh: 水生环境的变化会引发动物的应激反应，进而影响其自然行为并降低水产养殖产量。
text_en: Changes in the aquatic environment trigger stress responses in animals, which in turn affect their natural behavior and reduce aquaculture yields.

quote: the suitability of living environments can be assessed through behavioral changes
statement: 可以通过行为变化来评估生活环境的适宜性。
text_zh: 可以通过行为变化来评估生活环境的适宜性。
text_en: The suitability of the living environment can be assessed through behavioral changes.

quote: Artificial environments such as tanks, nets, and ponds can negatively impact the feeding activities, growth, health, and welfare of cultured fish under stressful conditions
statement: 在压力条件下，水箱、网箱和池塘等人工环境会对养殖鱼类的摄食活动、生长、健康和福利产生负面影响。
text_zh: 在压力条件下，水箱、网箱和池塘等人工环境会对养殖鱼类的摄食活动、生长、健康和福利产生负面影响。
text_en: Under stress conditions, artificial environments such as tanks, cages, and ponds have negative effects on the feeding activity, growth, health, and welfare of farmed fish.

population.system: 人工环境（水箱、网箱、池塘）

quote: introducing new habitats or altering their natural habitats can negatively affect fish welfare in aquaculture practices
statement: 引入新栖息地或改变其天然栖息地可能对水产养殖中的鱼类福利产生负面影响。
text_zh: 引入新栖息地或改变其天然栖息地可能对水产养殖中的鱼类福利产生负面影响。
text_en: Introducing new habitats or altering their natural habitats may have negative effects on fish welfare in aquaculture.

quote: The Kruskal–Wallis test was then applied to evaluate differences in the behaviors of the experimental fish under different habitat colorations.
statement: 使用Kruskal-Wallis检验来评估实验鱼在不同栖息地颜色下的行为差异。
text_zh: 使用Kruskal-Wallis检验来评估实验鱼在不同栖息地颜色下的行为差异。
text_en: The Kruskal-Wallis test was used to evaluate behavioral differences in experimental fish under different habitat colors.

quote: In the individual group, there was a significant difference in the percentage of time S. chuatsi spent in each color area (Kruskal–Wallis tests, p 0.01; Figure 2 a, Table A1 ).
statement: 在个体组中，中华鳜（S. chuatsi）在每个颜色区域停留的时间百分比存在显著差异。
text_zh: 在个体组中，中华鳜（S. chuatsi）在每个颜色区域停留的时间百分比存在显著差异。
text_en: In the individual group, there was a significant difference in the percentage of time spent by Chinese perch (S. chuatsi) in each color area.

quote: S. chuatsi spent the most time in the black area (47.10 ± 4.39%), followed by the blue (33.78 ± 3.70%), green (5.96 ± 0.97%), white (5.85 ± 1.63%), red (5.08 ± 1.27%), and the yellow (2.24 ± 0.36%) areas.
statement: 鳜鱼在黑色区域停留时间最长，其次是蓝色、绿色、白色、红色和黄色区域。
text_zh: 鳜鱼在黑色区域停留时间最长，其次是蓝色、绿色、白色、红色和黄色区域。
text_en: Mandarin fish spent the longest time in the black area, followed by blue, green, white, red, and yellow areas.

quote: fish farmers typically prioritize replicating natural habitats or creating better environments for fish
statement: 鱼类养殖者通常优先考虑复制自然栖息地或为鱼类创造更好的环境。
text_zh: 鱼类养殖者通常优先考虑复制自然栖息地或为鱼类创造更好的环境。
text_en: Fish farmers usually prioritize replicating natural habitats or creating a better environment for fish.

quote: experimental observations revealed the preferences of S. chuatsi and C. molitorella for different background colors under individual and group conditions, providing new perspectives for understanding the behavioral adaptations of the two species and shedding light on the culture welfare of these two species.
statement: 实验观察揭示了鳜和麦瑞加拉鲮在单独和群养条件下对不同背景颜色的偏好，为理解这两种物种的行为适应提供了新视角，并阐明了这两种物种的养殖福利。
text_zh: 实验观察揭示了鳜和麦瑞加拉鲮在单独和群养条件下对不同背景颜色的偏好，为理解这两种物种的行为适应提供了新视角，并阐明了这两种物种的养殖福利。
text_en: Experimental observations revealed the preferences of mandarin fish and Mrigal carp for different background colors under solitary and group-rearing conditions, providing new perspectives on understanding the behavioral adaptation of these two species and clarifying their aquaculture welfare.

quote: This predator–prey relationship is essential for the growth and health of S. chuatsi
statement: 这种捕食-被捕食关系对于鳜的生长和健康至关重要。
text_zh: 这种捕食-被捕食关系对于鳜的生长和健康至关重要。
text_en: This predator-prey relationship is crucial for the growth and health of mandarin fish.

quote: We set up a 5 min adaptation period, followed by a 20 min experimental shot [ 22 , 24 ].
statement: 设置了5分钟的适应期，随后进行20分钟的实验记录。
text_zh: 设置了5分钟的适应期，随后进行20分钟的实验记录。
text_en: A 5-minute adaptation period was set, followed by 20 minutes of experimental recording.

quote: During the experiment, the fish were placed into the center of the tank to acclimate to the experimental environment for five minutes.
statement: 实验期间将鱼放入水箱中心以使其适应实验环境五分钟。
text_zh: 实验期间将鱼放入水箱中心以使其适应实验环境五分钟。
text_en: During the experiment, fish were placed in the center of the tank to acclimate to the experimental environment for five minutes.

quote: The experimental environment was kept quiet during the experiment to avoid external interference.
statement: 实验期间保持环境安静以避免外部干扰。
text_zh: 实验期间保持环境安静以避免外部干扰。
text_en: During the experiment, environmental quietness was maintained to avoid external disturbances.

quote: However, in group experiments, due to the limitations of the automated tracking software, we used manual observation to analyze the time and number of visits, relying on observation only.
statement: 在群体实验中，由于自动跟踪软件的限制，使用人工观察来分析时间和访问次数。
text_zh: 在群体实验中，由于自动跟踪软件的限制，使用人工观察来分析时间和访问次数。
text_en: In group experiments, due to the limitations of automatic tracking software, manual observation was used to analyze time and number of visits.
limitations: 自动跟踪软件存在限制

quote: The present study offers insights into the behavior of S. chuatsi and C. molitorella regarding their habitat coloration preferences under both individual and group aquaculture conditions.
statement: 本研究提供了关于鳜鱼和麦瑞加拉鲮在个体和群体养殖条件下对栖息地颜色偏好的见解。
text_zh: 本研究提供了关于鳜鱼和麦瑞加拉鲮在个体和群体养殖条件下对栖息地颜色偏好的见解。
text_en: This study provides insights into the habitat color preferences of mandarin fish and Mrigal carp under individual and group rearing conditions.

quote: Experimental observations were conducted under six different habitat coloration (red, yellow, blue, green, black, and white).
statement: 实验观察在六种不同的栖息地颜色（红、黄、蓝、绿、黑和白）下进行。
text_zh: 实验观察在六种不同的栖息地颜色（红、黄、蓝、绿、黑和白）下进行。
text_en: Experimental observations were conducted under six different habitat colors (red, yellow, blue, green, black, and white).

quote: The scientific value of examining individual fish behavior lies in elucidating the mechanisms underlying these behaviors, thereby establishing a theoretical foundation for enhancing the culture environment, optimizing culture efficiency, and promoting fish welfare.
statement: 研究个体鱼类行为的科学价值在于阐明这些行为背后的机制，从而为改善养殖环境、优化养殖效率和促进鱼类福利建立理论基础。
text_zh: 研究个体鱼类行为的科学价值在于阐明这些行为背后的机制，从而为改善养殖环境、优化养殖效率和促进鱼类福利建立理论基础。
text_en: The scientific value of studying individual fish behavior lies in elucidating the mechanisms behind these behaviors, thereby establishing a theoretical foundation for improving farming environments, optimizing farming efficiency, and promoting fish welfare.

quote: This study may provide valuable insights for the aquaculture industry in terms of improving fish welfare and adaptation by adjusting habitat coloration, which can enhance aquaculture efficiency and fish health.
statement: 这项研究可能通过调整栖息地颜色来改善鱼类福利和适应性，从而为提高水产养殖效率和鱼类健康提供有价值的见解。
text_zh: 这项研究可能通过调整栖息地颜色来改善鱼类福利和适应性，从而为提高水产养殖效率和鱼类健康提供有价值的见解。
text_en: This study may improve fish welfare and adaptability by adjusting habitat color, thereby providing valuable insights for enhancing aquaculture efficiency and fish health.

quote: The mean water temperature was recorded as 18 ± 0.5 °C, the mean dissolved oxygen concentration was 8.0 ± 0.5 mg/L, and the pH was 7.9 ± 0.2.
statement: 记录的平均水温为18 ± 0.5 °C，平均溶解氧浓度为8.0 ± 0.5 mg/L，pH值为7.9 ± 0.2。
text_zh: 记录的平均水温为18 ± 0.5 °C，平均溶解氧浓度为8.0 ± 0.5 mg/L，pH值为7.9 ± 0.2。
text_en: The recorded average water temperature was 18 ± 0.5 °C, the average dissolved oxygen concentration was 8.0 ± 0.5 mg/L, and the pH value was 7.9 ± 0.2.

quote: Neither water changes nor aeration were performed during the experimental period.
statement: 在实验期间未进行换水或曝气。
text_zh: 在实验期间未进行换水或曝气。
text_en: No water exchange or aeration was performed during the experimental period.

quote: A running-water system was used in the experimental design, the duration of each experiment was relatively short (20 min), and a thorough water change operation was carried out at the end of each experiment.
statement: 实验设计使用了流水系统，每次实验持续时间相对较短（20分钟），并在每次实验结束时进行了彻底换水操作。
text_zh: 实验设计使用了流水系统，每次实验持续时间相对较短（20分钟），并在每次实验结束时进行了彻底换水操作。
text_en: The experimental design used a flow-through system, with each experiment lasting relatively short (20 minutes), and thorough water changes were performed at the end of each experiment.
intervention: Flow-through system with post-experiment water change
intervention_record: 流水系统与实验后换水
outcome: 水质更新与应激最小化

quote: No toxic physicochemical indicators, such as ammonia and nitrite, were discovered in the behavioral experiment, and what issues existed were not sufficient to have a significant impact on the behavior of the fish
statement: 在行为实验中未发现氨和亚硝酸盐等有毒理化指标，存在的问题不足以对鱼的行为产生显著影响。
text_zh: 在行为实验中未发现氨和亚硝酸盐等有毒理化指标，存在的问题不足以对鱼的行为产生显著影响。
text_en: In behavioral experiments, no significant impact on fish behavior was found from toxic physicochemical indicators such as ammonia and nitrite.

quote: The pattern of visit percentages was similar to the temporal pattern: blue (37.07 ± 9.50%), white (27.07 ± 5.83%), black (20.56 ± 6.94%), red (8.19 ± 3.01%), green (7.53 ± 2.77%), and yellow (5.71 ± 2.01%).
statement: 访问百分比的模式与时间模式相似：蓝色、白色、黑色、红色、绿色和黄色区域的顺序依次排列。
text_zh: 访问百分比的模式与时间模式相似：蓝色、白色、黑色、红色、绿色和黄色区域的顺序依次排列。
text_en: The pattern of visit percentages is similar to the temporal pattern: the order of blue, white, black, red, green, and yellow areas is arranged sequentially.

quote: Post hoc analysis revealed that the number of visits to the white area was significantly higher than to the red, yellow, and green areas ( p 0.05), and there were significantly more visits to the blue area than to the yellow area ( p 0.05). No significant differences were found among the remaining groups ( p 0.05; Figure 2 d, Table A1 ).
statement: 事后分析显示，对白色区域的访问次数显著高于红色、黄色和绿色区域，且对蓝色区域的访问次数显著多于黄色区域；其余组之间未发现显著差异。
text_zh: 事后分析显示，对白色区域的访问次数显著高于红色、黄色和绿色区域，且对蓝色区域的访问次数显著多于黄色区域；其余组之间未发现显著差异。
text_en: Post-hoc analysis showed that the number of visits to the white area was significantly higher than to the red, yellow, and green areas, and the number of visits to the blue area was significantly more than to the yellow area; no significant differences were found between the remaining groups.

quote: Post hoc comparisons revealed that S. chuatsi spent significantly more time in the black and blue areas compared to the other four colors ( p 0.05), with no significant difference among the red, yellow, green, and white areas ( p 0.05)

text_zh: 事后比较显示，与红、黄、绿、白四种颜色相比，鳜鱼在黑色和蓝色区域停留的时间显著更长，而红、黄、绿、白区域之间无显著差异。
text_en: Post-hoc comparisons showed that mandarin fish spent significantly longer in black and blue areas compared to red, yellow, green, and white areas, with no significant difference among the red, yellow, green, and white areas.

quote: The percentage of visits by individual S. chuatsi to each color area followed a similar pattern to the dwell time, with black (33.01 ± 3.18%), blue (28.35 ± 2.51%), green (13.37 ± 1.42%), red (9.54 ± 1.28%), yellow (8.74 ± 1.01%), and white (6.99 ± 1.12%) showing the same trend

text_en: The percentage pattern of individual mandarin fish visits to each color area was similar to the dwell time, with black being the highest, followed by blue, green, red, yellow, and white in order.

quote: Similar to dwell time, S. chuatsi visited the black and blue areas significantly more frequently than the other four colors ( p 0.05), while the number of visits to the red, yellow, green, and white areas did not differ significantly ( p 0.05;

text_zh: 与停留时间类似，鳜鱼访问黑色和蓝色区域的频率显著高于其他四种颜色，而访问红、黄、绿、白区域的次数无显著差异。
text_en: Similar to residence time, the frequency of mandarin fish visits to black and blue areas was significantly higher than that to the other four colors, while there was no significant difference in the number of visits to red, yellow, green, and white areas.

quote: S. chuatsi showed a preference for black and blue backgrounds, regardless of whether they were alone or in groups.

text_en: Mandarin fish (S. chuatsi) showed a preference for black and blue backgrounds, whether they were solitary or in groups.

quote: The dwell time in the yellow area was significantly lower than that in the blue, green, black, and white areas ( p 0.05), with no significant differences observed among the remaining colors ( p 0.05; Figure 3 b, Table A1 ).
statement: 黄色区域的停留时间显著低于蓝色、绿色、黑色和白色区域，其余颜色之间无显著差异。

text_en: The dwell time in the yellow area was significantly lower than in the blue, green, black, and white areas; there was no significant difference among the remaining colors.

quote: In terms of the frequency of visits, a significant difference was observed in C. molitorella groups in each color region (Kruskal–Wallis tests, p 0.01; Figure 3 d, Table A1 ).
statement: 在访问频率方面，C. molitorella 群体在每个颜色区域均观察到显著差异。

text_en: Regarding visit frequency, significant differences were observed in C. molitorella groups across each color area.

quote: Post hoc analysis revealed that the number of visits to the red region was significantly lower than that to the blue, green, black, and white regions ( p 0.05), and no significant difference was found regarding the visits to the yellow region ( p 0.05).
statement: 事后分析显示，对红色区域的访问次数显著低于蓝色、绿色、黑色和白色区域，而对黄色区域的访问次数无显著差异。

text_en: Post-hoc analysis showed that the number of visits to the red area was significantly lower than that to the blue, green, black, and white areas, while there was no significant difference in the number of visits to the yellow area.

quote: The percentage of visits to the yellow region was significantly lower than that to the green and black regions ( p 0.05), and no significant differences were observed among the other regions ( p 0.05, Figure 3 d, Table A1 ).
statement: 对黄色区域的访问百分比显著低于绿色和黑色区域，其他区域之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 对黄色区域的访问百分比显著低于绿色和黑色区域，其他区域之间无显著差异。
text_en: The percentage of visits to the yellow area was significantly lower than that to the green and black areas, with no significant difference between the other areas.

quote: These results reveal a clear preference for blue backgrounds in C. molitorella , with a marked difference between individual and group states.
statement: 研究结果显示，C. molitorella对蓝色背景有明确的偏好，且个体与群体状态之间存在显著差异。
text_zh: 研究结果显示，C. molitorella对蓝色背景有明确的偏好，且个体与群体状态之间存在显著差异。
text_en: The study results showed that C. molitorella has a clear preference for blue background, and there is a significant difference between individual and group states.

quote: The blue background may provide C. molitorella with richer visual information, aiding in recognition and enabling more effective utilization of environmental resources.
statement: 蓝色背景可能为C. molitorella提供更丰富的视觉信息，有助于识别并更有效地利用环境资源。

text_en: A blue background may provide C. molitorella with richer visual information, helping it to identify and more effectively utilize environmental resources.

quote: In group trials, C. molitorella demonstrates an enhanced ability to identify and utilize environmental resources through social interactions and information exchange.
statement: 在群体试验中，C. molitorella通过社会互动和信息交换表现出增强的识别和利用环境资源的能力。
text_zh: 在群体试验中，C. molitorella通过社会互动和信息交换表现出增强的识别和利用环境资源的能力。
text_en: In group trials, C. molitorella demonstrated enhanced ability to identify and utilize environmental resources through social interaction and information exchange.

text_en: The results indicate that habitat color plays an important role in influencing fish behavior and environmental adaptation.

quote: The findings revealed that S. chuatsi , both as individuals and groups, had advantages in the proportion of dwell time spent in black and blue areas and frequency of visits.
statement: 研究发现，无论是个体还是群体，鳜鱼在黑色和蓝色区域停留的时间比例以及访问频率方面均具有优势。

text_en: Combining residence time and visit frequency, these results indicate that mandarin fish prefer blue and black habitat colors.
